guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 以「從校正標準到可追溯水質時序」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
guides.conceptEn: Follow from calibration standards to traceable water-quality series through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
procedure: 在「位置與樣品代表性」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 4 min，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「停滯旁流管可能讓感測值落後於主流。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「兩點校正斜率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1.05 output/input，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「用兩點完全擬合不能證明全範圍線性。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「反算濃度與零點」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 3 input unit，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只乘修正係數而漏掉零點，低濃度誤差特別大。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「溫度補償的基準」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 1000 microS/cm，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把補償後讀值再補償一次會重複修正。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「清潔前後區分污損」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.4 measurement unit，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「先清潔再讀值會遺失污損證據。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「漂移率與時間插值」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.02 unit/day，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「沒有維護紀錄的回溯直線可能製造假趨勢。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「重複性與平均的不確定度」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.05 unit，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把高度自相關的100筆視為100個獨立樣本會低估誤差。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「響應時間與低通效應」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.950213 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只用穩態校正忽略動態誤差會錯過短脈衝。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「離群值旗標與原始保留」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.0416667 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「自動刪掉所有尖峰可能刪除真實事件。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
在「版本化與交接」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.95 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「使用最新係數改寫所有歷史資料會改變過去的量測基準。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
procedureEn: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for location and sample representativeness, first reproduce 4 min, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "A stagnant bypass can lag the main stream." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for two-point calibration slope, first reproduce 1.05 output/input, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Exact two-point fitting does not prove full-range linearity." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for invert concentration and offset, first reproduce 3 input unit, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "A scale-only correction misses offset, especially at low concentration." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for reference temperature compensation, first reproduce 1000 microS/cm, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Compensating an already corrected value applies the correction twice." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for separate fouling using cleaning checks, first reproduce 0.4 measurement unit, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Cleaning before recording loses evidence of fouling." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for drift rate and time interpolation, first reproduce 0.02 unit/day, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "A retrospective line without maintenance records can create a false trend." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for repeatability and uncertainty of the mean, first reproduce 0.05 unit, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Treating100 autocorrelated readings as100 independent samples understates uncertainty." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for response time and low-pass behaviour, first reproduce 0.950213 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Steady calibration alone misses dynamic error in short pulses." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for flag outliers and retain raw data, first reproduce 0.0416667 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Automatically deleting all spikes can remove real events." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

In the teaching model or spreadsheet for versioning and handover, first reproduce 0.95 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Applying the latest coefficients to all history changes the historical measurement basis." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.
evidence: 變更旁流量並比較事件到達時間。
增加第三個獨立標準檢查線性殘差。
對三筆模擬讀值套用正反轉換並比對。
固定鹽度，在兩個溫度檢查補償後是否一致。
先記錄再清潔，將差值放回最近維護區間。
加入一次跳變，說明線性校正何處失效。
比較連續密集讀值與間隔取樣的自相關。
用10秒脈衝與長階躍比較可觀測峰值。
將校正時段和真正尖峰使用不同旗標。
從一個報表點追溯到原始讀值與當時係數。
evidenceEn: Vary bypass flow and compare event arrival time.
Use a third independent standard to check linearity residual.
Apply forward and inverse transforms to three simulated readings.
Hold salinity fixed and compare compensated readings at two temperatures.
Record before cleaning and map the difference onto the maintenance interval.
Insert a step change and identify where linear correction fails.
Compare autocorrelation of dense readings and spaced samples.
Compare a10-second pulse with a sustained step.
Assign separate flags to calibration periods and genuine spikes.
Trace one report point to the raw reading and contemporaneous coefficients.
pitfalls: 停滯旁流管可能讓感測值落後於主流。
用兩點完全擬合不能證明全範圍線性。
只乘修正係數而漏掉零點，低濃度誤差特別大。
把補償後讀值再補償一次會重複修正。
先清潔再讀值會遺失污損證據。
沒有維護紀錄的回溯直線可能製造假趨勢。
把高度自相關的100筆視為100個獨立樣本會低估誤差。
只用穩態校正忽略動態誤差會錯過短脈衝。
自動刪掉所有尖峰可能刪除真實事件。
使用最新係數改寫所有歷史資料會改變過去的量測基準。
pitfallsEn: A stagnant bypass can lag the main stream.
Exact two-point fitting does not prove full-range linearity.
A scale-only correction misses offset, especially at low concentration.
Compensating an already corrected value applies the correction twice.
Cleaning before recording loses evidence of fouling.
A retrospective line without maintenance records can create a false trend.
Treating100 autocorrelated readings as100 independent samples understates uncertainty.
Steady calibration alone misses dynamic error in short pulses.
Automatically deleting all spikes can remove real events.
Applying the latest coefficients to all history changes the historical measurement basis.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

related.title: 新加坡新生水系統
related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。
courses.summaryEn: The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
